title: Context compaction runtime event payload (A6 explicit compaction)
description: A6 (2026-08-08): the controller compacted the conversation — old tool rounds were dropped whole (declaration + tool replies + injected pushes stay paired), the marker told the model history was compressed, and the compaction is journaled as this event. Trigger/target/interval are the design §5 A6 parameters (150K/100K/20).

trigger_tokens.description: Measured prompt tokens of the previous model round (provider usage.prompt_tokens) — the value that crossed the trigger.

target_tokens.description: Compaction target — kept conversation estimates under this.

rounds_since_last_compaction.description: Model rounds since the previous compaction (the ≥20-round cache-amortization interval, measured before this compaction).

rounds_dropped.description: Complete tool rounds dropped (each round = one assistant declaration plus its tool replies and injected pushes).

messages_kept.description: Messages remaining after compaction — preamble + kept rounds + the injected '前文上下文已压缩' marker (the marker is inserted before the count is journaled).

estimated_tokens_after.description: Estimated kept-conversation tokens (chars/2 — conservative CJK-aware estimate; the real next-round measurement is the authoritative follow-up).
